non_claims: the malonyl position and the sugar that carries it are not resolved
the aglycone comes from the hypothesis and is reported, not claimed
unit counts (hexoses, pentose, malonyl groups) are not claimed

notes: The CO2 loss is required but is not a claim ion; the claim rests on the malonyl loss (86.0004 Da) and the deprotonated aglycone of a flavonoid glycoside hypothesis carrying malonyl.
